summary.text: Sherry Giebler is the Democratic candidate for the Kansas House of Representatives, District 14, in the November 3, 2026 general election, where she faces Republican incumbent Charlotte Esau.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a retired public school counselor and educator with more than 30 years of experience.

paragraphs.text: Sherry Giebler was born in Salina, Kansas, and earned a high school diploma from Salina South High School, according to Ballotpedia.

In a Ballotpedia survey, she said she has lived in Johnson County since 1992 and earned a bachelor's degree in sociology, a master's degree in counseling and education, and an education specialist degree in educational leadership from Fort Hays State University.

She said her career included work as a teacher, school counselor, college counselor, adjunct professor and licensed professional counselor, and that she serves on the Johnson County Mental Health Advisory Board.
Giebler was the Democratic nominee for Kansas State Senate District 37 in 2024, when she lost the general election to Republican Douglas Shane.
In the survey, she listed public school funding, mental health care, and workers' rights among her priorities.
